build_nocaps_dataset: build a python module to create a NoCaps dataset from a COCO annotation file
load_nocaps_data_list: load the NoCaps dataset data list by reading COCO annotations and building image paths
register_nocaps_dataset: register the NoCaps dataset class in the mmpretrain DATASETS registry for use in training pipelines
review_nocaps_load_data_list: review the NoCaps load_data_list method to understand how it parses COCO annotations into data info dicts
summarize_nocaps_class: summarize the NoCaps class which extends BaseDataset to load image-caption pairs from COCO format annotations
